mapper.select: SELECT mmm.FACTORY_CODE, mmm.CX_MACHINE_CODE, mmm.CX_MACHINE_BRAND_CODE, mmm.CX_MACHINE_TYPE_CODE, mmm.IS_ZERO_RACK, mmm.LH_MACHINE_MAX_QTY, cmf.FIXED_STRUCTURE1, cmf.FIXED_STRUCTURE2, cmf.FIXED_STRUCTURE3, cmf.FIXED_MATERIAL_CODE, cmf.DISABLE_STRUCTURE, cmf.DISABLE_MATERIAL_CODE FROM t_mdm_molding_machine mmm LEFT JOIN t_mdm_cx_machine_fixed cmf ON cmf.FACTORY_CODE = mmm.FACTORY_CODE AND cmf.CX_MACHINE_CODE = mmm.CX_MACHINE_CODE AND IFNULL(cmf.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 WHERE IFNULL(mmm.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND mmm.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT wwi.FACTORY_CODE, wwi.WORK_WEAR_NAME, wwi.SPECIFICATION_MODEL, wwi.WORK_WEAR_TYPE, wwi.QTY, wwi.USED_TYPE FROM t_mdm_work_wear_info wwi WHERE IFNULL(wwi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND wwi.WORK_WEAR_STATUS = '1' AND wwi.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT dps.FACTORY_CODE, dps.MACHINE_CODE AS CX_MACHINE_CODE, dps.BEGIN_DATE, dps.END_DATE FROM t_mdm_device_plan_shut dps WHERE IFNULL(dps.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 AND dps.MACHINE_TYPE = '02' AND ((dps.BEGIN_DATE >= #{productionStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND dps.BEGIN_DATE <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE}) OR (dps.END_DATE >= #{productionStartDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND dps.END_DATE <= #{productionEndDate,jdbcType=DATE})) AND dps.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
